verdict.rationale: Vestd has data rooms for secure, central storage/sharing of documents and a digital cap table as source of truth, which together support the core need. However, evidence doesn't confirm granular permissioning specifically for counsel/investors, cap-table-plus-document combined views, or diligence-specific workflows. Missing for 10: explicit permission/role controls for external parties like counsel/investors, evidence of combined cap-table+document views in one shareable room, and independent/hands-on confirmation of the diligence workflow.
